paper_title: Tirzepatide for Weight Reduction in Chinese Adults With Obesity: The SURMOUNT-CN Randomized Clinical Trial.

true_research_question: In adults with obesity or overweight without diabetes who completed a 36-week open-label tirzepatide lead-in, does continued once-weekly maximum tolerated tirzepatide (10 or 15 mg), compared with withdrawal to placebo, maintain or augment weight reduction over the subsequent 52 weeks?

author: Jastreboff et al.
design_type: Phase 3 multicenter double-blind randomized placebo-controlled parallel-group trial
participant_type: Adults with obesity or overweight plus at least one weight-related complication, without diabetes
